Boční plank s horní nohou na lavici: spo: A side plank with the top leg on a bench: lift the bottom leg to the bench and slowly lower it. Start with the knee on the bench.
Horní nohu pokrčte a chodidlo položte na: Bend the top leg and place the foot on the floor in front of the bottom knee.
Horní nohu položte na lavici, na začátek: Place the top leg on the bench, at first with the knee, later with the ankle.
Kolena stlačte proti míči a vydržte 30 s: Squeeze the knees against the ball and hold for 30 seconds.
Lehněte si na bok vedle lavice, loket de: Lie on your side next to a bench, elbow under the shoulder.
Lehněte si na bok, hlavu opřete o spodní: Lie on your side and rest your head on your lower arm.
Lehněte si na záda, kolena pokrčte a mez: Lie on your back, bend your knees and put a ball or a rolled-up cushion between them.
Pomalu ji spusťte k zemi a pánev položte: Slowly lower it to the floor and put the pelvis down.

Spodní propnutou nohu zvedněte co nejvýš: Lift the straight bottom leg as high as you can and hold for 1 second at the top.

Studie zkoumaly hlavně fotbalisty, dávko: The studies looked mainly at footballers; the dosage for runners is a working assumption. Have groin pain that isn't linked to movement assessed.
Sílu přidávejte postupně, bolest při cvi: Increase the force gradually; pain during the exercise must not exceed 5 out of 10.
U dlouhodobé bolesti třísla z adduktorů: In long-standing adductor-related groin pain, an active strengthening programme in a randomised trial led to a pain-free return to sport far more often than passive physiotherapy (Hölmich et al., 1999). A programme with the Copenhagen plank reduced groin problems by roughly 40 % (Harøy et al., 2019).

Vleže na zádech s pokrčenými koleny stla: Lying on your back with bent knees, squeeze a ball between your knees and hold for 30 s. Force only into discomfort, not into sharp pain.
